narrative.overview:
The storefront reads as a quiet image gallery that happens to be searchable. The ground is white, fading to a soft neutral grey in the hero. Ink is near-black and warm greys do the rest of the work. Nothing in the chrome competes with the photographs: the wordmark and the product photographs are the only colour on the page. The first screen is one sentence and one working search, and the shopper is never asked to read a banner before finding a garment.

Every control is a full pill, and every image is a soft rounded tile with no card chrome. Headings are large, sentence-case, and set tight (negative tracking, leading near 1). Depth comes from tone (paper on mist on hairline) with a single soft float shadow reserved for things that sit above the page: the active nav pill, the search field, and the hero photo stack. The theme is applied at build time when VITE_THEME=gallery. The plain default look in theme.css remains the fallback when the variable is unset.
keyCharacteristics: White ground with a soft grey fade in the hero; no coloured backgrounds in the chrome.
Near-black ink as both accent and text; the wordmark and product photographs are the only colour.
Schibsted Grotesk throughout, 600 to 700 for headings, 500 for controls, tight negative tracking.
Full pill controls: buttons, search, nav, chips, cart and menu toggle.
Soft tiles (1.25rem radius, 4:5 ratio) for products; no borders or shadows on tiles.
One float shadow, used only for raised elements.
Large dimmed category list that resolves to ink on hover or focus.

rules.name: The Photographs Carry the Colour Rule
rules.body: Chrome is achromatic: ink, paper and warm greys only. Colour belongs to the wordmark and the product photographs. Amber and red are status signals and never decorative.

rules.name: The Tight Heading Rule
rules.body: Headings and display text are sentence case with tracking at -0.04em and leading near 1. Controls and labels are never tracked open; they stay at -0.01em.

rules.name: The Raised Only Rule
rules.body: Shadow appears only on elements that sit above the page. Resting tiles and controls are flat, and their depth is tonal.

rules.name: The Pill Controls Rule
rules.body: Every control is a full pill. Content is a soft rounded rectangle at 1.25rem. The two shapes never swap roles.

rules.name: The Dimmed Until Chosen Rule
rules.body: Category names rest in Dimmed grey and resolve to ink when hovered or focused. On touch screens they are always ink.

dos: Do use the [data-theme="gallery"] hook classes in src/styles/gallery.css (cta, cta-quiet, product-search, gallery-hero, gallery-cat, site-nav) for gallery surfaces, and switch new layout on isGallery from src/app/config/theme.ts.
Do keep headings sentence case, at -0.04em tracking, and at the display, headline and category sizes listed above.
Do use Dimmed (#85837f) only for large text, where it clears 3:1.
Do keep every control a full pill and every image on the 1.25rem tile radius.
Do honour prefers-reduced-motion: the placeholder cycle is skipped and the transitions and scales are removed.
donts: Don't put chromatic colour into the chrome (controls, navigation, borders or backgrounds). Colour belongs to the wordmark and the product photographs.
Don't add borders or shadows to product tiles. Tiles are tonal blocks on Mist.
Don't introduce square-cornered controls. Pills are the native control shape of this world.
Don't add a second shadow token. The float shadow is the only shadow in the system.
Don't use the plain default's small-corner or no-pill conventions in this theme.
